meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把产品链接或文案转成发布宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的产品要发布或展示,需要宣传视频。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a launch video.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're launching a product or feature and need a quick promo video.

howto.what: 把产品网址、文案或简介变成一支产品发布/宣传视频:先抓取网页素材、梳理品牌风格,再规划分镜和旁白,制作逐帧动画,最后渲染出 mp4 成片。
howto.when: 当用户想宣传、发布或推广某产品,给出商业网址,或要求网站导览/展示时触发;意图不明时转交 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个产品的官网做成一支发布宣传视频
say.note: 会先抓取网页素材,再规划分镜并渲染成片

say.text: 这是我们产品的简介文字,帮我做成发布视频
say.note: 会保存简介并按流程制作分镜和旁白

say.text: 给我们的新功能做个宣传短视频
say.note: 会按发布视频流程规划分镜并出片

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, marketing link, pasted script, or brief into a product-launch or promo video: captures the site, understands the brand, plans storyboard and script, builds frame-by-frame animation, and renders a final MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product, provides any commercial URL, or requests a site tour or showcase; unclear intents go to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this product's website into a launch video.
say_en.note: It captures the site and renders the full video.

say_en.text: Here is our product brief — make a launch video from it.
say_en.note: It saves the brief and plans storyboard and narration.

say_en.text: Make a promo for our new feature.
say_en.note: It follows the launch flow to plan shots and render.
